note: Round 87 (Jake, 2026-09-22: 'when you click on it... what it is, how it works. Very simple. This is a capacitor'). One card per part name, shown in the panel the moment a part is tapped. Keyed by the part's node name as walk.js's nodeName() gives it (numbered copies fold to one name). A key under _prefix matches any part whose name starts with it, for families like breaker_* and romex_*. Plain and short; two sentences at most: what it is, then how it works or what it is for.

parts.accumulator: Suction accumulator. A can on the suction line that catches liquid refrigerant so slugs of liquid never reach the compressor.
parts.aeration_pipe: Aeration pipe. Carries air from the blower down into the aeration chamber, where it bubbles up through the sewage and keeps the bacteria working.
parts.aerator: Aerator. The screen at the tip of the spout that mixes air into the stream. Scale packs it and the flow drops.
parts.air_diffuser: Air diffuser. Breaks the blower's air into fine bubbles at the bottom of the chamber so more of it dissolves.
parts.air_filter: Air filter. Screens the room air the heat pump pulls over its evaporator. Dirty, the unit falls back to its elements.
parts.air_inlet_filter: Air inlet filter. Screens the combustion air coming into the sealed burner.
parts.air_inlet_grille: Air inlet grille. Where the heat pump water heater draws room air in.
parts.air_intake: Combustion air intake. The opening the burner breathes through. Keep it clear of lint and boxes.
parts.air_line: Air line. Runs from the blower at the house to the aeration chamber. A crack here and the plant goes septic.
parts.air_outlet_grille: Air outlet grille. Where the heat pump blows the cooled, dried air back out.
parts.air_pump: Air pump. The linear blower that feeds the treatment plant. It runs all the time; a plant with no air goes septic in days.
parts.airlift: Airlift. A tube where rising air lifts settled solids from the clarifier back to the aeration chamber for another pass.
parts.alarm_lit: Alarm light. The red beacon on the panel. Lit means the water is above the alarm float or the air pump has stopped. Press test to prove it works.
parts.angle_stop: Angle stop. The small shutoff under the fixture. Quarter turn ones seal; old multi turn ones seize.
parts.angle_stop_multiturn: Multi turn angle stop. The old style stop with a compression stem. They seize and weep. Replace with a quarter turn.
parts.anode_access_cover: Anode access cover. The cap over the anode rod's hex head on top of the tank.
parts.anode_rod: Anode rod. A magnesium or aluminum rod that corrodes instead of the tank. Once it is eaten away the tank starts to rust.
parts.aux_pan: Auxiliary drain pan. The pan under an attic air handler that catches water if the primary drain clogs.
parts.aux_pan_drain: Aux pan drain. Runs the overflow pan to a spot outside where you will see it dripping, which is the warning.
parts.baffle: Baffle. A wall inside the tank that holds back scum and settled solids so only clear water reaches the outlet.
parts.ball_valve: Ball valve. A quarter turn shutoff. Handle in line with the pipe is open, across it is closed.
parts.ballcock: Ballcock. The old style fill valve with a float ball on an arm. Replaced by the float cup fill valve.
parts.base_elbow_1: Base elbow, pump 1. The elbow bolted to the basin floor that the pump seals onto when it rides down the rails. The pump lifts off it on the chain with nothing to unbolt.
parts.base_elbow_2: Base elbow, pump 2. The second pump's seat on the basin floor. Grit under the seal lets pumped water blow back into the basin.
parts.base_pan: Base pan. The bottom of the outdoor unit. Holds the compressor and coil and drains rain and defrost water out the bottom.
parts.basin: Basin. The tank the sewage collects in before the pump lifts it out.
parts.bib_wheel: Hose bib wheel. The handle. A drip at the stem with the wheel shut means the packing needs snugging or the washer is gone.
parts.bidet_seat: Bidet seat. A seat with a wash wand, fed from a tee at the supply stop.
parts.biomat: Biomat. The black slime layer that forms where effluent meets soil. Too thick and the field stops taking water.
parts.blower: Blower. Moves the air. On a furnace it pushes house air over the heat exchanger; on a septic plant it pumps air into the sewage.
parts.blower_air_filter: Blower air filter. The foam pad the air pump breathes through. Clogged, the pump overheats and the plant starves for air.
parts.blower_air_filter_cover: Blower filter cover. Lift it off to get at the foam pad.
parts.blower_cord: Blower cord. Plugs the air pump into its receptacle. Should be on a GFCI outside.
parts.blower_door: Blower door. Comes off to reach the blower and the control board. The door switch kills power when it is off.
parts.blower_housing: Blower housing. The snail shaped shell the wheel spins in.
parts.blower_motor: Blower motor. Turns the blower wheel. Either a fixed speed PSC motor with a capacitor or a variable speed ECM.
parts.blower_receptacle: Blower receptacle. The outdoor GFCI outlet the air pump plugs into.
parts.blower_wheel: Blower wheel. The squirrel cage that throws the air. Dirt on the fins cuts airflow before you can see it.
parts.board: Control board. The circuit board that runs the sequence: what starts, in what order, and what shuts it down.
parts.body: Valve body. The cast housing the flapper swings in, with the unions on each end.
parts.boiler_drain: Boiler drain. A hose bib on the tank tee for draining or testing the pressure tank.
parts.bonding_screw: Bonding screw. Ties the neutral bar to the panel can in a main panel only. Never in a subpanel.
parts.bottom_base: Base. The foot the water heater stands on.
parts.bowl: Bowl. Holds the water seal. The trap is cast into it.
parts.brine_float: Brine float. The safety float in the brine well that stops the salt tank overfilling.
parts.brine_lid: Brine tank lid. Lift it to check the salt level and look for a salt bridge.
parts.brine_line: Brine line. The small tube that draws brine from the salt tank during regeneration.
parts.brine_tank: Brine tank. Holds the salt. Water sits in the bottom and makes the brine that recharges the resin.
parts.brine_well: Brine well. The tube in the salt tank that keeps the float and the pickup clear of the salt.
parts.burner: Burner. Where the gas burns. Air and gas mix in the tube and the flame sits on the ports.
parts.burner_access_door: Burner access door. Covers the combustion chamber. Off, you can see the flame and the pilot.
parts.burner_assembly: Burner assembly. The burners, the manifold and the igniter, as one piece that comes out for cleaning.
parts.burner_door: Burner door. The upper panel on the furnace. Behind it are the burners, the igniter and the flame sensor.
parts.burner_flame: The flame. Should be blue and steady. Yellow or lifting off the burner means dirt or a draft problem.
parts.burners: Burners. One tube per port on the manifold. Rust and spider webs block them.
parts.bypass_valve: Bypass valve. Sends water around the softener so the house has water while it is serviced.
parts.cabinet: Cabinet. The box the unit lives in.
parts.cap_seal: Well cap seal. The gasket that keeps bugs and surface water out of the well.
parts.capacitor: Run capacitor. A can that stores a charge and gives the compressor and fan motors the push they need to start and keep turning. It weakens with age and heat; a bulged top means it is done.
parts.carbon_media: Carbon media. The bed the water filters through. It takes chlorine and taste out until it is spent.
parts.cartridge: Cartridge. The valve inside the faucet body that mixes hot and cold. Drips mean the seals in it are worn.
parts.cartridge_cold: Cold cartridge. The stem valve on the cold side of a two handle faucet.
parts.cartridge_hot: Hot cartridge. The stem valve on the hot side of a two handle faucet.
parts.casing: Well casing. The steel pipe lining the well. Should stand 12 inches above grade with the cap sealed.
parts.caulk: Caulk. The bead that keeps water out of the wall at the tub. Split caulk lets water into the framing.
parts.chain: Flapper chain. Links the trip lever to the flapper. Too long and it will not lift, too short and the flapper never seats.
parts.chamber: Chamber. A section of the tank.
parts.check_valve: Check valve. Lets water go one way only. Keeps the line from draining back into the pump when it stops.
parts.chlor_feed_tube: Chlorine feed tube. Holds the tablets where the treated water passes over them.
parts.chlor_tablets: Chlorine tablets. Calcium hypochlorite tablets that disinfect the treated water before it is sprayed. Pool tablets are the wrong kind and will not dissolve right.
parts.chlorinator: Chlorinator. The tube the tablets sit in. Treated water flows across the bottom tablet and picks up chlorine.
parts.chlorine_tablets: Chlorine tablets. Disinfect the treated water on its way to the spray heads. Check the stack every service.
parts.circuit_directory: Circuit directory. The list inside the panel door that says which breaker feeds what.
parts.clarifier: Clarifier. The quiet cone where the solids settle out after aeration, leaving clear water on top.
parts.cleanout: Cleanout. A capped opening in the drain line where a cable goes in to clear a stoppage.
parts.cleanout_cap: Cleanout cap. Unscrews to get a cable into the line.
parts.cleanout_plug: Cleanout plug. The threaded plug in the cleanout fitting.
parts.closet_bend: Closet bend. The elbow under the toilet that turns the waste down into the drain.
parts.co_detector: CO detector. Alarms on carbon monoxide. Every home with gas appliances needs one near the bedrooms.
parts.coil: Coil. Refrigerant tubing with fins. Air passes through it and heat moves in or out.
parts.coil_door: Coil door. The panel over the evaporator coil.
parts.cold_isolation_valve: Cold isolation valve. Shuts the cold inlet so the heater can be flushed through the service ports.
parts.cold_supply_line: Cold supply line. Brings cold water into the heater.
parts.cold_water_inlet: Cold water inlet. Where cold water enters the tank, down the dip tube to the bottom.
parts.combustion_chamber: Combustion chamber. The space under the tank where the burner fires.
parts.compressor: Compressor. The pump at the heart of the system. It squeezes the refrigerant gas so it gets hot enough to dump heat outside.
parts.compressor_terminal_cover: Terminal cover. Protects the compressor's three terminals: common, run and start.
parts.condensate_drain: Condensate drain. Carries the water that drips off the cold coil to a drain outside.
parts.condensate_line: Condensate line. Runs the acidic water from a condensing appliance to a drain, through a neutralizer where required.
parts.condensate_trap: Condensate trap. A water seal that lets condensate drain without letting flue gas out.
parts.condenser_coil: Condenser coil. The outdoor coil. The fan pulls air through it and the hot refrigerant gives up its heat.
parts.conduit: Conduit. Protects the wires where they run exposed.
parts.connections: Duct connections. Where the supply plenum and the return meet the cabinet. Gaps here leak conditioned air into the attic.
parts.contactor: Contactor. A heavy relay. The thermostat's 24 volts pulls it in and it closes the 240 volt circuit to the compressor and fan. Pitted contacts stick or chatter.
parts.control_board: Control board. Runs the sequence and shows fault codes on its LED.
parts.control_box: Control box. Where the contactor, the capacitor and the wiring live on the outdoor unit.
parts.control_panel: Control panel. Runs the pump from the floats and sounds the alarm when the water gets too high.
parts.cord: Cord. The plug in power lead.
parts.cord_grip: Cord grip. The fitting that clamps the cord where it enters the box and keeps water out.
parts.cords: Cords. The pump and float leads coming up the riser.
parts.crankcase_heater: Crankcase heater. Keeps the compressor oil warm when it is off so refrigerant does not settle into it.
parts.data_plate: Data plate. The label with the model, serial, capacity and ratings. Photograph it.
parts.deadfront: Dead front. The cover that hides everything but the breaker handles. Off, the bus is live.
parts.defrost_board: Defrost board. On a heat pump, runs the reversing valve for a few minutes to melt ice off the outdoor coil.
parts.diffuser: Diffuser. Spreads the air into fine bubbles at the bottom of the chamber.
parts.dip_tube: Dip tube. The plastic tube that carries cold water to the bottom of the tank so it does not mix with the hot water at the top. A broken one gives lukewarm water.
parts.disc_cartridge: Ceramic disc cartridge. Two polished discs that slide to open and mix. Long lasting, but grit scores them.
parts.discharge: Discharge line. Carries the pumped water out.
parts.discharge_tube: Discharge tube. Bolts to the disposer's outlet on its gasket and flange; it moves to a new disposer.
parts.disconnect: Disconnect. The switch or pull out at the unit that kills its power for service. Required within sight of the equipment.
parts.disconnect_pullout: Pull out. The block you pull to break the circuit. Turn it over and put it back to kill power with it in place.
parts.dishwasher: Dishwasher. Drains through the disposal or the sink tailpiece. Its drain hose needs a high loop or an air gap.
parts.display: Display. Shows the set point, the mode and any fault code.
parts.display_fault: Display, fault code. The unit stopped and is telling you why. Write the code down before you clear it.
parts.display_ok: Display, normal. Set point showing, no code.
parts.display_regen: Display, regeneration. The head is running a cycle: backwash, brine draw, rinse, refill. It should happen at night, when nobody is drawing water.
parts.disposal_body: Garbage disposal. A motor spins a turntable; the food is thrown against the grind ring and flushed out the discharge.
parts.disposal_cord: Disposal cord. Plugs into the switched receptacle under the sink.
parts.disposal_mount: Disposal mount. The three bolt ring that hangs the disposal from the sink flange.
parts.distributor: Distributor. Splits the refrigerant evenly into the coil's circuits.
parts.diverter: Diverter. Sends the water to the spout or up to the shower head.
parts.diverter_knob: Diverter knob. Pull it up and the water goes to the shower head.
parts.door_switch: Door switch. Kills the furnace when the blower door is off. Tape it down and the blower runs with the door open.
parts.draft_hood: Draft hood. The open cone on top of the heater where room air joins the flue gas. Soot or rust here means the exhaust is spilling into the room.
parts.drain_line: Drain line. Carries the waste or the condensate away.
parts.drain_pan: Drain pan. Catches water under the unit so a leak goes to the drain, not the ceiling.
parts.drain_valve: Drain valve. The hose bib at the bottom of the tank. Open it to flush the sediment out.
parts.drip_leg: Drip leg. A dead end tee below the gas valve that catches dirt and moisture before they reach it.
parts.drop_pipe: Drop pipe. The pipe the pump hangs on and pushes water up through.
parts.duct_connection: Duct connection. Where the supply and return ducts meet the unit. Gaps here waste conditioned air.
parts.effluent_filter: Effluent filter. A screen in the outlet tee that keeps solids out of the field. Pull it and hose it back into the tank.
parts.electrical_junction_box: Junction box. Where the field wiring meets the unit's wiring.
parts.escutcheon: Escutcheon. The trim plate that covers the hole in the wall or the deck.
parts.evap_coil: Evaporator coil. The indoor coil. Refrigerant boils inside it and pulls heat out of the air passing through.
parts.evaporator_coil: Evaporator coil. The cold coil. Air passes through it and comes out cooler and drier.
parts.exhaust_vent: Exhaust vent. Carries the flue gas out. On a condensing unit it is PVC and slopes back to the trap.
parts.expansion_tank: Expansion tank. A small tank with an air bladder that takes up the extra volume as the water heats. Without it the pressure spikes and the T&P weeps.
parts.fan: Fan. Pulls outdoor air through the coil.
parts.fan_grille: Fan grille. The guard over the fan. Keep leaves out of it.
parts.fan_motor: Fan motor. Turns the outdoor fan. Runs with the compressor on the contactor.
parts.faucet: Faucet. Mixes hot and cold in the cartridge and sends it out the spout.
parts.faucet_ball: Ball valve faucet. A slotted ball over springs and seats. Drips come from the springs and seats.
parts.faucet_handle: Handle. Lifts and turns the cartridge.
parts.faucet_pulldown: Pull down spray head. Comes off the spout on a hose. The counterweight pulls it back.
parts.feed_conduit: Feed conduit. Carries the power feed to the panel.
parts.fill_valve: Fill valve. Refills the tank after a flush. The float cup rides up on the water and shuts it off at the line.
parts.filter: Filter. Cleans the air before the blower. Change it or the coil takes the dirt instead.
parts.filter_door: Filter door. Slide it off to change the filter.
parts.filter_drier: Filter drier. Traps moisture and grit in the refrigerant line so they never reach the metering device.
parts.flame_sensor: Flame sensor. A rod in the flame that proves the burners lit. A coated rod cannot prove flame and the furnace shuts down after a few tries.
parts.flames: The flames. Blue and even across every burner is right.
parts.flange: Closet flange. The ring on the floor the toilet bolts to. A broken flange rocks the toilet and breaks the wax seal.
parts.flapper: Flapper. The rubber seal at the bottom of the tank. It lifts on the chain to flush and drops to seal. Worn, the toilet runs.
parts.flo_body: Flo shutoff valve. A motorized ball valve on the main with sensors that watch flow, pressure and temperature. It closes on a leak or from the app.
parts.flo_handle: Flo valve handle. Shows open or closed. It can be turned by hand if the power is out.
parts.flo_led: Flo status light. Blue is normal, red means it saw a leak and closed.
parts.flo_unions: Unions. Let the Flo valve come out of the line without cutting pipe.
parts.float: Float. Rides on the water and switches the pump on and off.
parts.float_alarm: Alarm float. The highest float. If the water reaches it the pump has failed and the alarm sounds.
parts.float_cup: Float cup. The cup on the fill valve that rides up on the tank water and shuts the valve.
parts.float_lag: Lag float. On a duplex station, brings the second pump on if the lead pump cannot keep up.
parts.float_lead: Lead float. Starts the lead pump.
parts.float_off: Off float. The lowest float. When the water drops below it the pump stops.
parts.float_on: On float. When the water lifts it the pump starts.
parts.float_onoff: Float switch. One tethered float that turns the pump on as it rises and off as it drops.
parts.float_switch: Float switch. A float on a cord; the tilt closes a switch inside and runs the pump.
parts.float_tree: Float tree. The pipe the floats clamp to, set at their heights, that lifts out for service.
parts.flow_sensor: Flow sensor. A small turbine in the inlet that tells the board water is moving and how fast. No flow, no heat; a slow reading against the rating means scale or a clogged inlet screen.
parts.flue: Flue. Carries the exhaust out through the roof.
parts.flue_baffle: Flue baffle. The twisted strip in the flue that slows the exhaust so it gives up more heat to the tank.
parts.flush_valve: Flush valve. The seat the flapper closes on and the overflow tube beside it. Water goes down it into the bowl when the flapper lifts.
parts.force_main: Force main. The pressure line from the pump up to the sewer.
parts.fresh_air_duct: Fresh air duct. Brings a little outside air into the return so the house is not sealed tight.
parts.furnace_trap: Furnace trap. Collects the condensate from the secondary heat exchanger and the inducer and drains it out.
parts.gas_connector: Gas connector. The flexible line from the shutoff to the appliance.
parts.gas_control_valve: Gas control valve. The thermostat and the gas valve in one. Turn the dial to set the temperature; it opens the gas to the burner when the tank cools.
parts.gas_drip_leg: Drip leg. The sediment trap below the gas valve.
parts.gas_drip_tee: Drip tee. The tee that makes the sediment trap on the gas line.
parts.gas_flex_connector: Gas flex connector. The corrugated stainless line between the shutoff and the unit.
parts.gas_manifold: Gas manifold. The pipe that feeds each burner through its orifice.
parts.gas_pipe: Gas pipe. The black iron line feeding the appliance.
parts.gas_riser: Gas riser. The drop that comes down to the appliance from the house gas line.
parts.gas_shutoff_valve: Gas shutoff. The lever valve at the appliance. Handle across the pipe is off.
parts.gas_valve: Gas valve. Opens on a 24 volt signal from the board once the pressure switch proves draft.
parts.gate_valve: Gate valve. A multi turn shutoff. Old ones will not close all the way.
parts.gauge: Pressure gauge. Reads the system pressure. It should swing between cut in and cut out as the pump cycles.
parts.ground_bar: Ground bar. Where every bare ground wire lands.
parts.ground_lug: Ground lug. Where the ground wire bolts on.
parts.head: Wall head. The indoor half of the mini split: a coil, a blower and a drain pan in a wall cabinet.
parts.heat_exchanger: Heat exchanger. The metal cells the flame heats from inside while the blower pushes house air over the outside. A crack lets exhaust into the house air.
parts.heating_chambers: Heating chambers. The tubes the elements sit in. Water flashes hot as it passes.
parts.heating_elements: Heating elements. The electric elements in the chambers. Scale coats them and they burn out.
parts.high_limit_control: High limit. The reset button on the upper thermostat. It trips if the tank overheats. If it keeps tripping, an element is grounded or a thermostat stuck.
parts.hoa_switch: Hand Off Auto switch. Hand runs the pump now, Off stops it, Auto lets the floats run it.
parts.hose_bib: Hose bib. The outside faucet. A frost free one has its seat inside the wall so the barrel drains and does not freeze; it must slope out to drain.
parts.hot_isolation_valve: Hot isolation valve. Shuts the hot outlet so the heater can be flushed through the service ports.
parts.hot_supply_line: Hot supply line. Carries hot water out of the heater to the house.
parts.hot_water_outlet: Hot water outlet. Where the hot water leaves the top of the tank.
parts.igniter: Igniter. A hot surface igniter glows or a spark electrode arcs to light the gas.
parts.impeller: Impeller. The spinning vanes inside the pump that throw the water.
parts.inducer: Inducer. A small fan that pulls the exhaust through the heat exchanger and out the flue before the burners light.
parts.inlet: Inlet. Where the flow comes in.
parts.inlet_filter_screen: Inlet screen. A fine screen on the cold inlet that catches grit before the heater. Pull it and rinse it.
parts.inlet_tee: Inlet tee. Drops the incoming sewage below the scum layer.
parts.inner_door: Inner door. The sealed panel over the combustion chamber.
parts.inner_tank: Inner tank. The glass lined steel tank inside the jacket.
parts.insulation: Insulation. The foam between the tank and the jacket.
parts.intake_vent: Intake vent. Brings outside air to the sealed burner.
parts.junction_box: Junction box. Where the pump and float leads are spliced to the feed. Must stay dry.
parts.ladder_door: Attic ladder door. The hinged panel in the ceiling. Springs hold it shut; pull the cord and it swings down with the ladder folded on it.
parts.ladder_frame: Ladder frame. The folding sections and the feet. The feet should sit flat on the floor with no gap or the hinges take the load.
parts.lead_green: Green lead. The ground lead from the surge device to the ground bar. Keep it short and straight; every extra inch lets more of the surge through.
parts.lid: Lid. The cover over the tank or basin. Should be secured so a child cannot lift it.
parts.lid_inlet: Inlet lid. The riser lid over the inlet end of the tank. Bolted down so a child cannot lift it.
parts.lid_outlet: Outlet lid. The riser lid over the outlet end, where the effluent filter is.
parts.lid_pump: Pump lid. The riser lid over the pump chamber. Under it are the pump, the float and the plug in wiring.
parts.lift_chain: Lift chain. Pulls the pump up its rail for service without anyone going in the basin.
parts.limit_switches: Limit switches. Shut the burners down if the furnace overheats, usually a dirty filter.
parts.lineset: Line set. The two copper lines between the indoor and outdoor units. The big insulated one is the suction line, the small one the liquid line.
parts.lineset_insulation: Line set insulation. Keeps the cold suction line from sweating and losing capacity.
parts.lower_heating_element: Lower element. Does most of the heating. Sediment settles on it and burns it out.
parts.lower_thermostat: Lower thermostat. Runs the lower element.
parts.main_breaker: Main breaker. Kills the whole panel.
parts.manifold: Manifold. Feeds each burner through its orifice.
parts.modulating_gas_valve: Modulating gas valve. Meters the gas up and down with the demand instead of full on or off.
parts.neutral_bars: Neutral bars. Where every white wire lands.
parts.outdoor_coil: Outdoor coil. The coil the fan pulls air through.
parts.outer_jacket: Jacket. The painted steel skin over the insulation.
parts.outlet_tee: Outlet tee. Keeps scum from leaving with the clear water. The effluent filter sits in it.
parts.overflow_plate: Overflow plate. The plate on the tub wall. Behind it the overflow drains into the waste.
parts.p_trap: P trap. The bend that holds water and blocks sewer gas.
parts.pad: Pad. What the unit sits on. It should be level and clear of the wall.
parts.pan_drain_line: Pan drain line. Runs the drain pan to a spot where a drip shows.
parts.pilot_assembly: Pilot assembly. The small standing flame that lights the burner and the thermocouple that proves it is lit.
parts.pitless_adapter: Pitless adapter. The fitting below frost that passes the water line out through the casing without a hole above ground.
parts.popup_linkage: Pop up linkage. The rod behind the faucet that lifts and drops the drain stopper.
parts.power_cord: Power cord. Plugs the unit into its receptacle.
parts.pressure_relief_valve: Pressure relief valve. Opens if the pressure climbs too high.
parts.pressure_switch: Pressure switch. Starts the pump at cut in and stops it at cut out. On a furnace, proves the inducer is pulling draft before the gas opens.
parts.pressure_tank: Pressure tank. Air over a diaphragm over water. It stores pressure so the pump does not start every time a tap opens.
parts.primary_heat_exchanger: Primary heat exchanger. The first pass, where the flame heats the water.
parts.pump: Pump. Moves the water. A float or a switch turns it on.
parts.pump_cable: Pump cable. The submersible cable down to the pump, taped to the drop pipe.
parts.pump_filter: Pump filter. The screen around the pump intake that keeps solids out of the spray heads.
parts.receptacle: Receptacle. The outlet the unit plugs into.
parts.refrigerant_lines: Refrigerant lines. The suction and liquid lines at the service valves.
parts.regen_packets: Regeneration. Brine drawn from the salt tank flows through the resin and strips the hardness off it, then the rinse sends it down the drain.
parts.reservoir: Reservoir. The small tank the condensate pump collects water in before it pumps it out.
parts.resin_tank: Resin tank. Holds the resin beads that trade sodium for hardness.
parts.reversing_valve: Reversing valve. On a heat pump, swaps which coil is hot and which is cold so it can heat or cool.
parts.riser: Riser. The ring that brings the tank access up to grade.
parts.riser_tube: Riser tube. The center tube the softened water comes up through.
parts.run_capacitor: Run capacitor. Stores a charge that helps the motor start and run smoothly. Weak or bulged, the motor hums and will not start.
parts.safety_leads: Safety switch leads. Two wires from the condensate pump's float switch to the furnace. If the reservoir overfills the switch opens and the furnace stops calling for heat instead of flooding the closet.
parts.salt_bed: Salt. Keep the tank at least a third full. A hard crust with a hollow under it is a salt bridge.
parts.scale_inhibitor: Scale inhibitor. A cartridge on the cold water line that keeps minerals from forming scale in the water heater.
parts.scum_layer: Scum. The layer of grease and light solids on top. The baffles hold it back from the outlet.
parts.secondary_heat_exchanger: Secondary heat exchanger. On a condensing furnace, pulls the last heat out of the exhaust until water condenses.
parts.sediment: Sediment. The scale and grit that settles at the bottom of the tank. It rumbles when it boils and cooks the lower element.
parts.service_valves: Service valves. The two valves on the outdoor unit with the gauge ports for checking pressures.
parts.sewer_line: Sewer line. The house drain out to the tank or the street.
parts.shower_arm: Shower arm. The pipe from the wall to the head.
parts.shower_head: Shower head. Scale plugs the holes; vinegar dissolves it.
parts.silence_button: Silence button. Quiets the alarm horn. The light stays on until the level drops.
parts.sludge: Sludge. The settled solids. Pump the tank when it fills a third of the depth.
parts.sludge_blanket: Sludge blanket. The settled solids in the bottom of the plant.
parts.spd_body: Surge protective device. Clamps a surge on the bus to ground before it reaches the circuits.
parts.spd_breaker: SPD breaker. The two pole breaker the surge device hangs on.
parts.splash_guard: Splash guard. The rubber baffle in the sink flange. Torn, it throws water back up.
parts.spout: Spout. Where the water comes out.
parts.spray_head: Spray head. Pops up and turns to spread the treated water over the lawn.
parts.spray_head0: Spray head. Pops up under pressure and turns to spread the treated water over the lawn. Drops flush when the pump stops.
parts.spray_line: Spray line. Runs from the pump to the heads.
parts.spray_pattern: Spray pattern. The circle the head wets. It should stay on the lawn, clear of the house, the drive and the neighbour, with the heads overlapping a little.
parts.start_capacitor: Start capacitor. A bigger short duty capacitor that gives the compressor a hard kick on start, then drops out.
parts.start_packets: Start current. The inrush the compressor draws for a fraction of a second when the contactor closes. The soft starter trims it so the lights do not dim and a generator can carry it.
parts.start_relay: Start relay. Switches the start capacitor out of the circuit once the compressor is up to speed.
parts.status_led: Status light. Green means protected. Off or red means the device has done its job and needs replacing.
parts.stem_cold: Cold stem. The compression stem behind the cold handle. A washer on its end seals on the seat; a worn washer drips at the spout, worn packing leaks behind the handle into the wall.
parts.stem_hot: Hot stem. The compression stem behind the hot handle. Washer drips show at the spout, packing leaks show behind the handle.
parts.stop_cold: Cold stop. The shutoff on the cold supply under the fixture.
parts.stop_hot: Hot stop. The shutoff on the hot supply under the fixture.
parts.strainer: Strainer. The basket in the sink drain.
parts.suction_line: Suction line. The big insulated line carrying cold refrigerant gas back to the compressor.
parts.supply_cold: Cold supply line. From the stop to the faucet.
parts.supply_hot: Hot supply line. From the stop to the faucet.
parts.supply_line: Supply line. The braided line from the stop to the tank.
parts.surge_protector: Surge protector. Clamps a surge before it reaches the unit's board and contactor.
parts.tailpiece_left: Tailpiece. The straight pipe from the strainer down to the trap.
parts.temperature_sensors: Temperature sensors. Tell the board the water temperature in and out.
parts.terminal_block: Terminal block. Where the field wires land.
parts.test_button: Test button. Runs the alarm to prove it works.
parts.thermostat_wire: Thermostat wire. The low voltage cable from the thermostat.
parts.tp_discharge_connection: T&P discharge. Pipes the relief valve to within 6 inches of the floor or outside, never capped.
parts.tp_relief_valve: T&P relief valve. Opens if the tank gets too hot or the pressure too high. Lift the lever once a year; if it drips after, replace it.
parts.transformer_24v: 24 volt transformer. Makes the control voltage for the thermostat and the board.
parts.trip_lever: Trip lever. The flush handle and the arm that lifts the chain.
parts.turntable: Turntable. The spinning plate in the disposal with the swivel lugs that throw the food.
parts.txv: TXV. The thermostatic expansion valve. It meters liquid refrigerant into the coil by the temperature its bulb feels on the suction line.
parts.txv_bulb: TXV bulb. Strapped to the suction line and insulated. It senses the outlet temperature and opens or closes the valve.
parts.ul_flapper: Uni lateral flapper. The hinged disc inside the check valve. It swings open as the pump pushes water up and drops shut when the pump stops so the force main does not drain back.
parts.union: Union. A fitting that comes apart so the piece can be removed.
parts.upper_heating_element: Upper element. Heats the top of the tank first, then hands off to the lower element.
parts.upper_thermostat: Upper thermostat. Runs the upper element and holds the high limit reset button.
parts.uv_light: UV coil light. A lamp beside the coil that keeps mold and bacteria from growing on the wet coil and the drain pan.
parts.valve_body: Valve body. The mixing valve in the wall behind the trim.
parts.valve_box: Valve box. The buried box over the bypass valves.
parts.valve_head: Valve head. The control on top of the softener that runs the regeneration.
parts.vent: Vent. Lets air in and out as the level changes.
parts.vent_pipe: Vent pipe. Carries the exhaust out.
parts.waste_overflow: Waste and overflow. The tub's drain shoe and the overflow, joined to the trap.
parts.wax_ring: Wax ring. Seals the toilet to the flange. Once it is broken it never reseals.
parts.well_cap: Well cap. Seals the top of the casing with a vent screen and the conduit for the pump cable.
parts.whip: Whip. The flexible conduit from the disconnect to the unit.
parts.wiring_harness: Wiring harness. The unit's own wiring between the board and its parts.
parts.flapper_bad: Worn flapper. Warped and scaled, it no longer seals on the flush valve seat, so water leaks into the bowl and the tank refills on its own.
parts.handle_loose: Loose trip lever. The handle wallows in the tank hole, so the flush is weak or the lever sticks down.
parts.chain_loose: Loose chain. Too much slack, the lever cannot lift the flapper clean and the flush is short.
parts.chain_broken: Broken chain. The lever no longer lifts the flapper at all.
parts.seat_scaled: Scaled flush valve seat. Mineral on the seat keeps even a new flapper from sealing.
parts.base_gap: Gap at the base. The toilet rocks, and a rocking toilet breaks the wax seal.
parts.base_stain: Stain at the base. Water has been getting out under the toilet: the wax ring or the flange.
parts.flange_broken: Broken closet flange. The bolts have nothing solid to hold, so the toilet cannot be held down or sealed.
parts.bolts_seep: Seeping tank bolts. Water weeping past the tank to bowl bolt gaskets.
parts.heatex_rust: Rust on the heat exchanger. Surface rust today; watch it for a breach.
parts.heatex_soot: Soot on the heat exchanger. The flame is not burning clean: check combustion air, the burners and the venting.
parts.hx_crack: Cracked heat exchanger. Combustion gas can get into the house air. The furnace is not safe to run.
parts.hx_hole: Rusted through heat exchanger. A hole between the flame side and the house air. Not safe to run.
parts.capacitor_bulged: Bulged capacitor. The top is domed or leaking: it has failed or is about to, and the motor will not start right.
parts.contactor_pitted: Pitted contactor. Burnt, pitted contacts make a poor connection, run hot and can weld shut.
parts.disconnect_scorch: Scorched disconnect. Heat marks from a loose or overloaded connection.
parts.coil_dirty: Dirty condenser coil. Dirt and lint in the fins keep the unit from getting rid of heat: higher bills, higher head pressure.
parts.coil_dust: Dusty indoor coil. Dust on the coil chokes the airflow and the cooling.
parts.coil_frozen: Iced coil. Low airflow or low charge let the coil freeze.
parts.blower_wheel_dirty: Caked blower wheel. Dirt on the blades cuts the air the blower can move.
parts.aux_pan_rust: Rusted secondary pan. Rusted through or cracked, it will not catch an overflow.
parts.stem_leak_hot: Leaking hot stem. The seat and washer are worn, so hot water drips from the spout.
parts.stem_leak_cold: Leaking cold stem. The seat and washer are worn, so the spout drips.
parts.head_scale: Scaled shower head. Mineral in the nozzles, so the spray is weak and uneven.
parts.drain_clog: Clogged drain. Hair and soap slowing the drain.
parts.trap_leak: Leaking trap. Water seeping at the slip joints.
parts.trap_metal_corroded: Corroded metal trap. Eaten thin, it will leak.
parts.cabinet_damage: Water damaged cabinet floor. Stained and swollen from a leak above it.
parts.grind_ring_rust: Rusted grind ring. The disposal is wearing out inside.
parts.splash_guard_torn: Torn splash guard. Food and water come back up out of the disposal.
parts.jam_debris: Jammed disposal. Something hard stuck in the grinding plate: it hums but will not spin.
parts.cord_scorched: Scorched cord ends. Heat at the connection: an electrical hazard.
parts.mount_gap: Loose disposal mount. The unit has worked loose on its mounting ring.
parts.flange_weep: Weeping sink flange. Water getting past the putty under the sink flange.
parts.s_trap: S trap. An old style trap with no vent: it can siphon dry and let sewer gas into the house.
parts.intake_fouled: Fouled pump intake. Solids built up on the pump intake.
parts.duct_dryer_vent: Dryer vent. The duct that carries the dryer's hot, lint laden air outside. A long, crushed or packed run is a fire risk.
parts.duct_dryer_vent_lint: Lint packed in the dryer vent. It slows the dryer and it is what dryer fires start in.
parts.duct_dryer_vent_hood: Dryer vent hood. Where the vent ends outside. The damper must swing open and there must be no screen to catch lint.
parts.duct_dryer_vent_damper: Dryer vent damper. Opens with the airflow and closes to keep pests and cold out.
parts.dehumidifier: Whole home dehumidifier. Pulls moisture out of the house air through the duct system when the AC is not running long enough to.
parts.ice_stop: Ice maker stop. The shutoff for the refrigerator's water line. A saddle valve that pierces the pipe is the kind that leaks.
parts.ice_line: Ice maker line. The small line that feeds the refrigerator. Old gray poly and brittle copper crack and leak behind the fridge.
parts.faucet_base_puddle: Water at the faucet base. The faucet is leaking at the deck.
parts.faucet_loose_gap: Loose faucet. The faucet has worked loose in the deck.
parts.blower_air_filter_dirty: Dirty blower air filter. A clogged intake filter starves the air pump.
parts.whs_box_ground_screw: Green ground screw. The steel box is bonded.
parts.whs_connector_box: 3/8 in flex connector in the box's top knockout.
parts.whs_connector_heater: 3/8 in flex connector in the heater's junction box, beside the feed.
parts.whs_handy_box: Steel handy box on the post. The splices live here.
parts.whs_handy_box_screws: Wood screws holding the box to the post.
parts.whs_handy_cover: Blank cover. Take it off to see the splices.
parts.whs_jbox_leads: In the heater's junction box. Blacks on L1 and L2 with the feed, green on the ground screw.
parts.whs_led_dark: Light out with the power on. The device is spent, it is not protecting anything.
parts.whs_led_lit: Green light on. The surge parts inside are still good.
parts.whs_led_text: Status light. Look at it every visit.
parts.whs_mov_1_burnt: Burnt MOV. It took one surge too many and its thermal link let go.
parts.whs_post: 2x4 stand off nailed to the rafter and the platform. Something solid to mount on in an attic.
parts.whs_post_nails: Nails through the rafter and toe nails into the deck.
parts.whs_soot: Black soot at the nipple and on the housing. The device has failed, replace it.
parts.whs_spd_body: Surge protective device (Type 1 / Type 2, 240 V). Wired across the heater's two hots and ground.
parts.whs_spd_body_section: Cut open. Three MOVs potted in the housing, each with a thermal link.
parts.whs_spd_label: Rating label. 120/240 V single phase, green light means protected.
parts.whs_spd_lead_white: Device lead, white. On a 240 V heater it goes to GROUND, not a neutral (there is none).
parts.whs_spd_leads_inside: Factory leads out of the potting.
parts.whs_spd_nipple: 1/2 in threaded nipple into the handy box. The leads run up its bore.
parts.whs_surge_bolt: Surge coming in on the line.
parts.whs_surge_bolt_ground: The surge dumped to ground through the device instead of through the heater's controls.
parts.whs_thhn_green: #12 THHN ground to the heater's ground screw.
parts.whs_whip: 3/8 in flexible metal conduit. The leads ride in it to the heater.
parts.whs_whip_strap: One hole strap. The flex is fastened to the post.
parts.whs_wire_nuts: Wire nuts. Tug test every one.
parts.cold_check: Spring check on the cold feed, arrow toward the valve. Hot cannot push back into the cold line.
parts.cold_line: 3/4 in CPVC cold from the tee around to the COLD port.
parts.cold_tee: Tee on the cold supply above the heater's shutoff. The cold for the mixing valve.
parts.hot_line: 3/4 in CPVC hot from the heater's hot outlet, over the tank top and down into the HOT port.
parts.mixed_coupling: Where the house hot line picks up the tempered water.
parts.mixed_line: Tempered water out of the bottom of the valve.
parts.packets_scald: Tank temperature going straight to the taps.
parts.shuttle_stuck: Shuttle jammed up on the cold seat. The hot is wide open and the cold is shut.
parts.tmv_body: Thermostatic mixing valve, 3/4 in, at the heater. Hot in one side, cold in the other, tempered water out the bottom to the house.
parts.tmv_body_section: Valve cut open. The shuttle between its two seats, the wax element under it, the inlet checks.
parts.tmv_bonnet: Bonnet with the setting scale, 80 to 120 F.
parts.tmv_cap: Locking adjustment cap. Loosen the screw on top and lift it off to reach the stem.
parts.tmv_element: Wax thermostat. It swells in hotter water and moves the shuttle toward the hot seat.
parts.tmv_internals: Seats, springs, the check valves in both inlets and the filter washers.
parts.tmv_marks: Cast marks. H is the hot inlet, C the cold inlet, M and the arrow the mixed outlet. Piped backwards, it cannot work.
parts.tmv_shuttle: Shuttle between the hot seat and the cold seat. It throttles both at once to hold the set temperature.
parts.tmv_stem: Adjusting stem. Counterclockwise is hotter, clockwise is cooler. Set it by the thermometer at the nearest tap, not by the marks.
parts.tmv_unions: Union ends. The valve comes out without cutting pipe. Filter washers and checks sit behind them.
parts.cold_crimp_90_b: Brass crimp 90 into the COLD tail.
parts.cold_tube_a: Blue PEX-B from the tee to the check.
parts.cold_tube_b: Blue PEX-B out to the front.
parts.cold_tube_c: Blue PEX-B across the front, held in a tube talon.
parts.cold_tube_d: Blue PEX-B into the valve's cold tail.
parts.crimp_joint_section: Crimp joints cut open. The tube over the barb ribs, butted to the shoulder, the copper ring 3/16 in back from the tube end, crimped down.
parts.hot_connector: 18 in corrugated stainless water heater connector, FIP nut on the hot nipple, PEX barb on the far end. No PEX in the first 18 in off a water heater.
parts.hot_crimp_90_hi: Brass crimp 90. The turn is too tight to bend the tube (minimum bend about 5 in on 3/4).
parts.hot_crimp_90_lo: Brass crimp 90 into the HOT tail.
parts.hot_tube_drop: Red PEX-B down in front of the tank.
parts.hot_tube_in: Red PEX-B into the valve's hot tail.
parts.hot_tube_top: Red PEX-B from the connector to the first crimp 90, a copper crimp ring at each end.
parts.mixed_tube: Red PEX-B, tempered water down off the outlet tail.
parts.pex_supports: 2x4 stakes toe nailed to the platform with nail on tube talons. The valve and its tube are carried, not hanging on the fittings.
parts.adapter: 5 V 2 A plug in adapter in the outlet under the monitor.
parts.adapter_unplugged: Adapter pulled out of the outlet. The monitor goes dark and stops reporting.
parts.co2_sensor: CO2 sensor (NDIR). CO2 climbs when people are in a closed up house.
parts.cord_channel: Paintable cord channel. Keeps the cable neat down the wall to the outlet.
parts.display_dark: Blank screen. No power to the monitor.
parts.display_good: Green ring and status light. The air is good.
parts.display_poor: Red ring and status light. Poor air. CO2 and VOC are high: the house needs fresh air, the filter and ventilation get checked.
parts.display_window: The display lens. The small dot at the top right is the light sensor.
parts.env_sensors: VOC sensor and the humidity and temperature sensor, beside the exhaust grille.
parts.led_board: The LED matrix behind the lens that draws the numbers.
parts.monitor_body: The monitor. Air comes in the slots on the left side and out the grille on the right. Keep both sides clear, 2 in or more.
parts.monitor_body_section: Cut open. The dust sensor behind the intake, the CO2 sensor and the humidity, temperature and VOC sensors on the main board.
parts.monitor_unit: Air quality monitor (Awair Omni class). Reads CO2, VOC, fine dust (PM2.5), humidity and temperature in the room.
parts.pm_sensor: Laser dust sensor (PM2.5). Its fan pulls room air in through the side slots.
parts.power_button: Power button on the right side.
parts.readings_a: Live readings. Air score, CO2, VOC, PM2.5, humidity, temperature.
parts.sensor_board: Main board with the Wi-Fi module.
parts.usb_cable: USB-C power cable into the bottom of the monitor.
parts.media_air_clean_up: Filtered air leaving the top, into the furnace blower.
parts.media_air_dusty_in: Room air in through the grille, dust and all.
parts.media_air_dusty_up: Dusty air rising into the bottom of the media.
parts.media_cabinet: Media cabinet (20 x 25, 2210 class) laid flat under the furnace. The air goes up through it.
parts.media_cabinet_section: Cabinet cut open. The pleated media sits in its channels between the two openings.
parts.media_door: Cabinet door. Two latches, the airflow arrow points at the furnace.
parts.media_frame: Media ends and the blue spacers that keep the pleats open.
parts.media_loaded: Loaded media. Grey and caked on the bottom (inlet) side. Past due, the blower is starving for air.
parts.media_pleats: Deep pleat media, MERV 13. About 60 pleats folded like an accordion.
parts.media_return_grille: Return grille, no filter in it. The media does the filtering now.
parts.media_return_panel: Block off panel over the old filter grille hole.
parts.media_supports: Angle rails on 2 x 4 posts. The cabinet does not hang from the furnace.
parts.media_transition: Transition from the cabinet up to the furnace's bottom opening, foil taped and sealed.
parts.cell_dark: Lamp out and cell spent. Nothing is being made. Replace the cell (about every 2 years).
parts.halo_cord: 18/2 cord up the wall and along the plenum to the unit's jack.
parts.halo_duct_cut: The 3-1/4 in hole in the plenum.
parts.halo_foil_ring: Foil ring round the 3-1/4 in hole.
parts.halo_gasket: Foam gasket under the plate. Seals the hole.
parts.halo_housing: Purifier on its plate. Three screws, lamp window, 24 V jack. UV-C inside, power off before you pull it.
parts.halo_probe: Probe in the supply air. UV-C lamp inside a catalytic cell, ionizer brushes on the tip.
parts.halo_probe_section: Probe cut open. The lamp down the middle, the cell round it.
parts.halo_transformer: 24 VAC transformer on a box beside the furnace switch. Off when the furnace is off.
parts.status_glow: Lamp window. Lit means the lamp is on.
parts.cold_packets: Cold air. It stops at the shell.
parts.cover_cutaway: The cover cut open. Bib, breaker and cord inside.
parts.cover_foam: Foam lining. This is what holds the heat in.
parts.cover_gasket: Foam gasket. Seals flat against the siding all the way round.
parts.cover_gasket_gap: Cover cocked off the wall. Daylight at the gasket, cold air gets straight to the bib.
parts.cover_hook: Hook on the end. Pull the cord tight and hook it.
parts.cover_loop: Cord loop over the handle, onto the stem. It pulls the cover to the wall.
parts.cover_shell: Insulated faucet cover. Hard plastic shell over foam, the big size that fits over a vacuum breaker.
parts.cover_shell_section: The cover cut open. Bib, breaker and cord inside.
parts.vb_air_packets: Air drawn in at the vent. It breaks the siphon.
parts.vb_body: Hose connection vacuum breaker, brass, 3/4 in hose thread in and out (Watts NF8 class, the frost free bib model).
parts.vb_body_section: The breaker cut open. Check disc, spring, vent ports under the cap.
parts.vb_adapter: Adapter. Screwed on the bib's thread and locked there by the snapped set screw. It stays when the breaker is rebuilt.
parts.vb_lower_body: Lower body. Unscrews from the adapter by hand to rebuild the breaker (Watts RK-NF8 kit).
parts.vb_gasket_washer: Gasket washer. The bib's thread end seals on it. It comes in the RK-NF8 kit.
parts.vb_cap: Vent cap. The atmospheric vent opens under its skirt.
parts.vb_check_disc: Check disc. Pushed open by the supply, snaps shut when pressure drops.
parts.vb_hose_packets: The hose drains back into the bucket, not into the house.
parts.vb_hose_thread: Hose thread. The hose goes on here, never straight on the bib.
parts.vb_set_screw: Breakaway set screw, head snapped off. The breaker can't be unscrewed.
parts.vb_story_bucket: Bucket of dirty water. What back siphoning would pull into the house.
parts.vb_story_hose: A hose left running into a bucket.
parts.vb_vent_drip: Water out of the vent with the bib on. The disc is not seating.
parts.warm_band: Heat coming out of the house along the bib. The cover keeps it there.
parts.cabinet_section: Cabinet cut open. Foam lined, the core in the middle, a blower low at each end.
parts.control_button: Integrated control. Push for off, low, high (leave it off to use the wall control).
parts.control_cable: Wall control cable from the unit, under the trunk and down the hall wall.
parts.control_led: LED. Amber low, green high, off means off or on the wall control, blinking is a fault code.
parts.core: Enthalpic core. Membrane plates stacked so house air and outside air pass each other in alternate layers and trade heat and moisture, never mixing.
parts.core_clogged: Core packed with lint and dust in its channel mouths. The filters were left too long.
parts.core_filters: The two core filters (washable foam) on the faces where outside air and house air come in.
parts.core_section: Core cut open. The two air streams cross through it in alternate plates.
parts.door: Bottom door. Two latches on the south edge, hinged on the north edge. Core and filters come out here.
parts.duct_exhaust_out: 5 in insulated flex from the exhaust port up to the exhaust roof cap.
parts.duct_fresh_in: 5 in insulated flex from the intake roof cap to the fresh air port.
parts.duct_stale_in: 5 in insulated flex from the kitchen ceiling grille to the stale air port.
parts.duct_supply_out: 5 in insulated flex from the fresh-to-building port to the steel connection on the trunk.
parts.electrical_drawer: Removable electrical drawer with the integrated push button control.
parts.grille_stale: Stale air grille in the kitchen ceiling, 12 ft from the range (Broan. At least 4 ft).
parts.hangers: Four chains and springs to eye screws in two rafters. The springs keep the hum out of the house.
parts.hood_exhaust: Exhaust roof cap with its gravity damper, higher on the roof than the intake.
parts.hood_intake: Intake roof cap, screened. 6 ft 4 in from the exhaust cap and below it, more than 10 ft from the plumbing vents and the water heater flue.
parts.interlock_cable: Air handler interlock. Brings the furnace or air handler blower on whenever the ERV runs.
parts.port_exhaust_out: Port. EXHAUST AIR TO OUTSIDE (lower, cold end), balancing damper wide open.
parts.port_fresh_in: Port. FRESH AIR FROM OUTSIDE (upper, cold end).
parts.port_stale_in: Port. EXHAUST AIR FROM BUILDING (upper, warm end).
parts.port_supply_out: Port. FRESH AIR TO BUILDING (lower, warm end), balancing damper wide open.
parts.receptacle_strut: 2 x 4 strut from the ceiling joist to the rafter, carries the receptacle box.
parts.wall_control: Broan VT4W main wall control on the living room side of the hall wall.
parts.airline_seal_18in: Air line through a 7/8 in hole in the 18 in riser, sealed with mastic.
parts.airline_seal_24in: Air line through a 7/8 in hole in the 24 in riser, sealed with mastic.
parts.blend_bag: SludgeHammer Blend bag on its 1/2 in stick, tee handle a few inches under the lid. Pull it, check the coating, zip tie a new packet on.
parts.centre_tube: 4 in centre tube. The air lift. Bubbles from the air line coupling at its foot carry liquid up through the unit.
parts.centre_tube_section: Centre tube cut open. The air line and the Blend bag inside it.
parts.clear_tube: Clear tube from the pump outlet to the barb, two hose clamps. No kinks.
parts.column: SludgeHammer S-46. Black HDPE column, 12 in across, 36 in tall, standing on the tank floor in the first compartment.
parts.column_section: Column cut open. The media wound round the 4 in centre tube.
parts.control_box_alarm_lens: Alarm light. Lights when the air pressure drops.
parts.control_post: 4 x 4 post for the alarm box.
parts.media: Cuspated fixed-film media wrapped round the centre tube. Where the bacteria grow.
parts.media_section: Media cut open. Layers of corrugated plastic.
parts.receptacle_gfci: GFCI receptacle in the basin. Test and reset it before blaming the pump.
parts.rope: Rope tied through the lugs, the spare tied off round the air line. The unit comes up on it.
parts.sensor_tee: Air pressure sensor tee between two close nipples, the PVC 90 and the barb.
parts.sensor_wire: Pressure switch wires to the alarm box.
parts.backfill_bedding: 6 in of stone under the tank.
parts.baffle_broken: Baffle broken. Grease and solids go straight through to the outlet side.
parts.baffle_broken_section: Baffle broken, a piece of it lying on the floor.
parts.building_sewer: 6 in building sewer to the city main.
parts.co_downstream: Two way cleanout after the interceptor.
parts.co_lot_line: Two way cleanout inside the lot line.
parts.co_restroom: Two way cleanout on the restroom line.
parts.co_upstream: Two way cleanout before the interceptor. Rod or jet the inlet line from here.
parts.floor_lot_commercial_pad: Concrete traffic pad round the frames, flush with the asphalt.
parts.frame_inlet: Cast iron traffic frame, set 1/4 in under the pavement.
parts.frame_middle: Cast iron traffic frame over the baffle.
parts.frame_outlet: Cast iron traffic frame over the outlet tee.
parts.grease_cap: Grease cap floating on top. Normal, a few inches.
parts.grease_cap_high: Grease cap down to the outlet tee's mouth. Grease is going out to the city sewer. Pump it now.
parts.grease_cap_high_section: Grease cap far too thick, down to the outlet.
parts.grease_cap_section: Grease cap. Measure it with a sludge judge, grease plus solids under a quarter of the depth is OK.
parts.grease_carryover: Grease up the outlet tee, down the outlet line and in the sample box. The city's inspector finds this.
parts.grease_line: Grease waste from the kitchen, 4 in, out under the back wall.
parts.restroom_line: The restroom's sanitary line. Goes round the interceptor, never through it.
parts.rings_inlet: Precast grade rings. Bring the frame up to the pavement (2 rings max, 12 in max).
parts.rings_middle: Precast grade rings on the middle access.
parts.rings_outlet: Precast grade rings on the outlet access.
parts.sample_box: Sampling box. The pipe runs through as an open channel so a cup can take what leaves the interceptor.
parts.sample_box_section: Sampling box cut open. The channel.
parts.solids: Settled food solids on the floor. Normal.
parts.solids_high: Solids over the crossover and up to the outlet tee. They carry over. Pump it.
parts.solids_section: Solids on the floor, under the crossover.
parts.tap_saddle: Tap on the city sewer main.
parts.vac_hose: Pump truck hose down the inlet side. Pump both compartments, the whole tank.
parts.door_store_back: Kitchen back door to the lot.
parts.fix_dishwasher: Dish machine. Drains to floor sink B by an air gap, through the interceptor.
parts.fix_hand_sink: Hand sink. Its own trap, on the grease line.
parts.fix_mop_sink: Mop sink. On the grease line, mop water carries grease too.
parts.fix_prep_sink: Prep sink. Indirect waste to floor sink B (food prep sinks must not connect direct).
parts.fix_three_comp_sink: 3 compartment sink. Wash, rinse, sanitize. The biggest grease source in the kitchen; it drains to floor sink A by an air gap.
parts.grease_cleanout: Cleanout at the building exit on the grease line.
parts.grease_drain: Grease waste under the slab, separate from the restroom. Every kitchen fixture, out the back wall to the interceptor.
parts.grease_vent: 3 in vent on the grease line, out the roof. The interceptor breathes through it.
parts.kitchen_floor_sink_a: Floor sink A, under the 3 compartment sink. Indirect waste lands here, half grate.
parts.kitchen_floor_sink_b: Floor sink B. The dish machine and the prep sink air gap into it.
parts.sanitary_drain: The restroom's sanitary line. Under the kitchen, out the back, round the interceptor.
parts.anode_rod_pitted: Anode rod, pitted. Years in the tank have eaten it down to a rough, thin rod. It is still working, but it is close to done: price a new one.
parts.anode_rod_bare: Anode rod, used up. Only the steel core wire is left. Nothing is protecting the tank now, so the tank itself starts to rust. Replace it.
parts.exp_tank_waterlogged: Expansion tank, waterlogged. The diaphragm has failed or the air charge is gone, so the tank is full of water and cannot take up the expansion. The relief valve drips instead.
parts.element_buried: Lower element buried in sediment. The scale has built up over the element, so it runs hot inside the pile and fails early. Flush the tank or replace the element.
parts.lower_element_glow: Lower element heating. It comes on when the lower thermostat calls, heating the water at the bottom of the tank.
parts.exp_tank_diaphragm: Diaphragm. The rubber wall inside the expansion tank: water on one side, the air charge on the other.
parts.exp_tank_water_chamber: Water side of the expansion tank. Hot water pushes in here as it expands.
parts.exp_tank_air_chamber: Air side of the expansion tank. The air charge squeezes as the water comes in, then pushes it back out.
parts.outer_jacket_section: The tank cut open: the steel jacket, the foam, the glass lined tank and the water inside.
parts.water_volume_section: The water in the tank, cut open so the dip tube, the anode and the sediment show through it.
parts.lid_middle: Middle cover. The traffic rated cast iron cover over the baffle, where you check the crossover and measure both sides.
parts.lid_cracked: Cracked lid. A cover that is cracked or not seated is a fall hazard and lets water and dirt in. Replace it with a rated lid.
parts.lid_unrated: Plastic lid in traffic. A light duty lid where cars drive will break. It needs a traffic rated (H-20) cover and frame.
parts.outlet_tee_corroded: Outlet tee corroded. The tee has rotted off, so grease and solids go straight out to the sewer. Replace the tee.
parts.inlet_greased: Inlet line greased up. A ring of grease inside the inlet line is closing it off. Jet the line and look at what goes down the drains.
parts.tank_bolts: Tank bolts. The bolts that hold the tank down on the bowl, each with a rubber washer inside the tank. When the washers age they seep, and the floor behind the toilet stains slowly.
parts.strainer_right: Basket strainer. The drain fitting in the sink bowl, sealed to the sink with putty under its lip. When the putty fails it drips onto the cabinet floor, not into the drain.
parts.strainer_left: Basket strainer, left bowl. Sealed to the sink with putty under its lip; a failed seal drips onto the cabinet floor.
parts.panel: Pump control panel. The simplex panel on the girder that feeds the sump pump on its own circuit and sounds the alarm when the water rises past the alarm float.
parts.dw_hose: Dishwasher drain hose. Runs from the machine up in a high loop and into the disposal or the tailpiece. Without the loop or an air gap, sink water can siphon back into the dishes.
parts.dw_supply: Dishwasher supply line. The hot water line from its own stop under the sink to the machine. Kinks and corrosion hide behind an appliance nobody moves.
parts.flo_body_section: Flo valve, cut open. The motorized ball valve inside, with the flow, pressure and temperature sensors that decide when to close it.
parts.drain_tee: Drain tee. Where the tub drain and the overflow meet under the tub before the trap. A weep here shows on the ceiling below, not in the bathroom.
parts.filter_left: Filter screen, left. The washable screen behind the mini split's front panel. Pull it and rinse it; choked, the head runs all day and never satisfies.
parts.filter_right: Filter screen, right. The second washable screen behind the mini split's front panel. Hold it up to the light: no light through it, no air through it.
parts.condensate_stub: Condensate drain. Where the water the coil pulls out of the air leaves the gas pack's cabinet. It has to drain away and be seen, not pool on the pad.
parts.pump_1: Grinder pump 1. One of the two pumps in the duplex station, on its own rail. It grinds the waste and pushes it up the force main; the panel swaps lead and lag every cycle.
parts.pump_2: Grinder pump 2. The second pump in the duplex station. Two pumps so the house still drains when one is down.
parts.check_valve_1: Check valve, pump 1. Holds the force main full when its pump stops so the basin does not refill from the line.
parts.check_valve_2: Check valve, pump 2. The second pump's check valve on the discharge header.
parts.float_pump: Pump float. Rides the water in the sump basin and starts the pump when the water lifts it. Hung on a cord or the basin wall, it never rises and the pump never starts.
parts.dryer_exhaust_collar: Dryer exhaust collar. Where the vent duct clamps onto the back of the dryer. Crushed when the machine was pushed back, taped with the wrong tape, or not connected at all are the three to look for.
parts.rheem_badge: Rheem badge. The maker's name on the cabinet. It comes off with the panel it is on.
parts.warning_label: Warning label. The safety and wiring label on the panel. Read it before the panel comes off.
parts.nameplate_label: Nameplate. The model and serial label on the side discharge unit, on the panel it rides on.
parts.orifice_ring: Fan orifice ring. The ring in the top cap the fan blade spins through. It comes off with the shell.
parts.discharge_muffler: Discharge muffler. A can on the compressor's discharge line that quiets the pulses before the reversing valve.
parts.handle_cover: Handle cover. The small cover over the panel latch on the side discharge unit.
parts.whip_entry: Whip entry. Where the flexible conduit from the disconnect enters the unit's control box.
parts.front_panel: Front panel. The panel on the front of the unit. On a mini split head it swings up for the filter screens; on a side discharge condenser it comes off for the control box and the valves.
parts.rear_panel: Rear panel. The removable panel on the back of the side discharge unit, over the coil.
parts.top_panel: Top panel. The lid of the side discharge unit. Off, the fan and the partition are reachable.
parts.valve_cover: Valve cover. The cover over the refrigerant service valves on the outdoor unit. Off, the valves and the gauge ports are reachable.
parts.thermostat_line: Thermostat wire. The low voltage cable from the thermostat to the furnace's control board.
parts.trench1: Drain field trench. A gravel trench with a perforated line in it where the tank's clear water soaks into the soil. Cut open, the stone, the pipe and the soil under it show.
parts.trench2: Drain field trench, second run. The D box splits the flow between the runs; each one has to take its share.
parts.diffuser_clogged: Clogged diffuser. The air stone at the bottom of the chamber is fouled, so the blower runs and little bubbles up. The plant is not getting its oxygen.
parts.disposal_leak: Leaking disposal body. Water coming out of the shell itself, not a joint. The unit is finished; it is replaced, not repaired.
parts.filter_dirty: Loaded filter. Grey and caked, it is choking the blower. Hold it up to the light: no light through it, no air through it.
parts.float_pump_stuck: Stuck pump float. Hung on the cord or the basin wall, it cannot rise, so the pump never starts and the basin fills.
parts.flue_corroded: Corroded flue. Rust eating the vent pipe at a joint. Exhaust can spill into the room before the pipe falls apart.
parts.lid_buried: Buried lid. The tank lid is under the grass with no riser to grade. Every service starts with a shovel until a riser is added.
parts.salt_bridge: Salt bridge. A hard crust of salt with a hollow under it. The tank looks full but no brine is being made, so the softener has not regenerated in months.
parts.sludge_high_section: Sludge too deep. The settled solids are up to the outlet, so solids leave with the water toward the field. Pump the tank.
parts.stop_crust: Crusted stop. Green or white crust at the angle stop is corrosion working on the connection. It weeps, then it lets go.
parts.stop_seep: Seeping stop. A damp ring and crust at the stop under the sink; the packing or the compression joint is going.
parts.supply_corroded: Corroded supply line. The braided line from the stop is green and crusted at the nut. It fails all at once at full pressure.
parts.supply_line_old: Old supply line. A braided line past its life, corroded or bulging at the nut behind the toilet.
parts.water_high_section: Water too high. The level is above the outlet, so the field is not accepting what the tank sends it.
parts.ahc_fuse: Board fuse. A blade fuse on the 24 V side; blown means a short somewhere in the low voltage.
parts.blower_assembly: Blower assembly. Housing, wheel, motor and control box: slides out on its track.
parts.drain_plug_aux_horizontal: Auxiliary drain plug. Closes the port not in use.
parts.drain_plug_aux_vertical: Auxiliary drain plug. Closes the port not in use.
parts.field_wiring: Field wiring. The house's power conductors on the heat kit breaker.
parts.filter_arrow: Airflow arrow. Points the way the air goes: at the unit.
parts.heater_breaker: Heat kit breaker. Protects the electric heat strips; its handle comes through the blower door.
parts.heater_limit_1: Heat strip limit. Opens if its strip overheats (low airflow).
parts.sequencer_1: Sequencer. Brings a heat strip on a little after the call and off a little after.
parts.sequencer_2: Sequencer. Brings the second strip on after the first.
parts.uv_lamp: UV lamp. Kills mold on the wet coil; change it every year or two.
parts.cap_lead_c_comp: Capacitor lead, C to the compressor's R. Pulls straight up off its tab after the can is discharged.
parts.cap_lead_c_line: Capacitor lead, C to the contactor. Pulls straight up off its tab with insulated pliers, after the can is discharged.
parts.cap_lead_fan: Fan motor lead, brown, on the capacitor's FAN post. Part of the motor: it comes off with the motor.
parts.cap_lead_herm: Capacitor lead, HERM to the compressor's S (start). Pulls straight up off its tab after the can is discharged.
parts.cap_tab_c: Capacitor C terminal. The common post: the line lead and the compressor's run lead both land here.
parts.cap_tab_fan: Capacitor FAN terminal. The fan motor's brown lead lands here.
parts.cap_tab_herm: Capacitor HERM terminal. The compressor's start winding lead lands here.
parts.capacitor_strap: Capacitor strap. Holds the can to the plate; loosen its screw and the can lifts out.
parts.comp_term_c: Compressor terminal C (common), on the fusite under the terminal cover.
parts.fan_motor_cable: Fan motor cable. The motor's leads in their loom, down the corner to the control box.
parts.liquid_port_cap: Liquid gauge port cap. Over the Schrader core.
parts.liquid_valve_cap: Liquid valve stem cap. The stem's primary seal when back seated.
parts.suction_port_cap: Suction gauge port cap. Over the Schrader core where the gauges go.
parts.suction_valve_cap: Suction valve stem cap. The stem's primary seal when the stem is back seated: snug it back on.
parts.top_assembly: The top: cap, guard, fan motor and blade. Comes off as one, set upside down beside the unit.
parts.dfc_as_plug: Ambient sensor plug on the defrost board (AS).
parts.dfc_ds_plug: Defrost sensor plug on the defrost board (DS).
parts.reversing_valve_coil: Reversing valve coil. The solenoid that shifts the valve between heating and cooling; slides off the pilot.
parts.j_bend: J bend. The U of the trap that holds the water seal. It comes down on its two slip nuts: back them off, pull it straight down over a bucket.
parts.p_trap_arm: Trap arm. From the J to the trap adapter in the wall. It stays: the house drain starts behind its escutcheon.
parts.j_nut_in: Slip nut. It threads onto the J and squeezes a beveled washer round the pipe that slides in. Hand tight and a quarter.
parts.j_nut_out: Slip nut. It threads onto the J and squeezes a beveled washer round the trap arm. Hand tight and a quarter.
parts.j_washer_in: Slip washer. The seal at a slip joint: its taper faces the fitting. In backwards, it drips.
parts.j_washer_out: Slip washer. The seal at a slip joint: its taper faces the fitting. In backwards, it drips.
parts.waste_tee_body: Baffle tee. Where the disposer's arm and the right bowl's tailpiece join and turn down into the trap.
parts.strainer_body: Basket strainer body. Set in putty from above, held by the locknut from below. A drip down its outside is the putty.
parts.strainer_basket: Strainer basket. Lifts out by its knob.
parts.strainer_locknut: Strainer locknut. Holds the strainer body down to the sink over its two gaskets.
parts.strainer_coupling_nut: Coupling nut. Holds the tailpiece's flange up against the strainer.
parts.mount_lower_ring: Lower mounting ring. Its three lugs ride up the flange's ramps; turned left with a wrenchette, the disposer drops free.
parts.jam_hex: Jam release. A 1/4 in hex in the bottom centre turns the plate by hand: work it back and forth until it spins, then push reset.
parts.reset_button: Reset button. The motor's overload. Wait a few minutes after a jam, then push it lightly.
parts.stator: Stator. The motor's fixed windings, filling the housing.
parts.rotor: Rotor. Spins inside the stator on the shaft.
parts.motor_shaft: Motor shaft. Carries the plate; its bottom end has the jam release hex.
parts.discharge_90: Disposer 90. Takes the discharge tube on a slip nut and turns it into the waste arm.
parts.stop_hot_body: Hot stop. The shutoff on the hot supply under the fixture; this one has a second outlet for the dishwasher.
parts.stop_cold_body: Cold stop. The shutoff on the cold supply under the fixture.
parts.stop_hot_ferrule: Ferrule. The brass ring the compression nut crushes onto the copper. It stays on the stub when the stop comes off.
parts.stop_cold_ferrule: Ferrule. The brass ring the compression nut crushes onto the copper. It stays on the stub when the stop comes off.
parts.stop_hot_comp_nut: Compression nut. Two wrenches: hold the stop, turn the nut.
parts.stop_cold_comp_nut: Compression nut. Two wrenches: hold the stop, turn the nut.
parts.supply_hot_nut: Line nut. The faucet line's 3/8 compression nut on the stop's outlet.
parts.supply_cold_nut: Line nut. The faucet line's 3/8 compression nut on the stop's outlet.
parts.handle_lever_pulldown: Faucet handle. Pop the plug button, loosen the 3/32 set screw, and it pulls off the cartridge stem.
parts.handle_dome_pulldown: Handle dome. Covers the cartridge nut; it comes off after the handle.
parts.cartridge_1255: Moen 1255 cartridge. Lies in the side of the body under the handle. A drip from the spout or a stiff handle is this cartridge.
parts.cartridge_nut_pulldown: Cartridge nut. Holds the cartridge in; change it with the cartridge.
parts.faucet_spout_pulldown: Spout. Swivels on the body and carries the pull down hose to the wand.
parts.fc_hose: Pull down hose. A leak under the sink only when the wand is out is this hose.
parts.hose_weight: Hose weight. Pulls the wand back into its dock.
parts.wand_screen: Wand screen. Low flow from the wand is a packed screen.
parts.dw_hose_clamp: Hose clamp. Holds the dishwasher drain hose on the disposer's inlet.
parts.float_bracket: Float bracket. A stainless angle under the basin's rim that the float cords hang from, each through its own cord grip.
parts.cord_grip_off: Cord grip. Loosen its cap and the float's cord slides to set the float's height; snug it and the float stays put.
parts.cord_grip_lead: Cord grip. Loosen its cap and the float's cord slides to set the float's height; snug it and the float stays put.
parts.cord_grip_lag: Cord grip. Loosen its cap and the float's cord slides to set the float's height; snug it and the float stays put.
parts.cord_grip_alarm: Cord grip. Loosen its cap and the float's cord slides to set the float's height; snug it and the float stays put.
parts.float_off_weight: Cable weight. Clamped on the float's cord at its switching level; the float tips on a short tether below it.
parts.float_lead_weight: Cable weight. Clamped on the float's cord at its switching level; the float tips on a short tether below it.
parts.float_lag_weight: Cable weight. Clamped on the float's cord at its switching level; the float tips on a short tether below it.
parts.float_alarm_weight: Cable weight. Clamped on the float's cord at its switching level; the float tips on a short tether below it.
parts.float_off_cord: Float cord. Carries the float's switch back to the junction box; it hangs the float at its height.
parts.float_lead_cord: Float cord. Carries the float's switch back to the junction box; it hangs the float at its height.
parts.float_lag_cord: Float cord. Carries the float's switch back to the junction box; it hangs the float at its height.
parts.float_alarm_cord: Float cord. Carries the float's switch back to the junction box; it hangs the float at its height.
parts.float_cords: Float cords. The four float leads from the bracket to the junction box.
parts.junction_box_body: Junction box. Where the pump and float leads are spliced to the feed. Must stay dry.
parts.lid_rim: Lid. The cover over the basin; this is its rim.
parts.lid_gasket_rim: Cover gasket. Seals the basin's cover so sewer gas goes out the vent, not around the lid.
parts.lid_gasket: Cover gasket. Seals the basin's cover so sewer gas goes out the vent, not around the lid.
parts.lid_bolt_1: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_2: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_3: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_4: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_5: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_6: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_7: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.lid_bolt_8: Cover bolt. Holds the basin's cover down; keeps kids and the curious out.
parts.jb_cover_gasket: Junction box gasket. Keeps rain out of the splices.
parts.jb_cover_screw_1: Cover screw. Captive in the junction box cover.
parts.jb_cover_screw_2: Cover screw. Captive in the junction box cover.
parts.jb_cover_screw_3: Cover screw. Captive in the junction box cover.
parts.jb_cover_screw_4: Cover screw. Captive in the junction box cover.
parts.check_valve_1_disc: Check valve disc. Swings open when the pump pushes, drops shut when it stops so the line does not drain back.
parts.check_valve_2_disc: Check valve disc. Swings open when the pump pushes, drops shut when it stops so the line does not drain back.
parts.ball_valve_1_ball: Valve ball. Bored through: along the pipe it is open, a quarter turn across it is shut.
parts.ball_valve_2_ball: Valve ball. Bored through: along the pipe it is open, a quarter turn across it is shut.
parts.union_tail_up: Union tail. The half of the union glued on the run out of the riser. It stays when the pump comes up.
parts.union_tail_low: Union tail. The half of the union glued on the pump's riser pipe. It comes up with the pump.
parts.union_nut: Union nut. Turn it by hand to part the union; it stays on the lower tail and comes up with the pump.
parts.union_oring: Union O-ring. Seals the two tails. Left out or nicked, the union weeps back into the tank every cycle.
parts.discharge_lower: Pump riser pipe. From the pump up to the union. You pull the pump up by it.
parts.discharge_upper: Discharge run. From the union up, through the riser wall, out to the spray line. It stays.
parts.cords_on_pipe: Pump cord and float wire, zip tied down the pipe. They come up with the pump.
parts.cords_loop: Service loop. The cords over the lip tab and down in a slack loop to the splices, so the pump can come up without cutting anything.
parts.chlor_tee_drop: Chlorinator tee. The glued tee the tablet tube stands in; the water turns down past the bottom tablet here.
parts.bolts_pump: Lid screws. Eight stainless screws hold the lid down so a child cannot lift it.
parts.bolts_aer: Lid screws. Eight stainless screws hold the lid down so a child cannot lift it.
parts.bolts_inlet: Lid screws. Eight stainless screws hold the lid down so a child cannot lift it.
parts.blower_internals: Air pump guts. The magnet drives a rod back and forth; a diaphragm on each end pumps the air.
parts.blower_magnet: Electromagnet. Its coil drives the rod back and forth sixty times a second. It stays when the heads come off.
parts.diaphragm_rod: Rod. Carries the two diaphragm blocks. The second block comes out with it.
parts.diaphragm_head_l: Head (casing) block. Holds the check valves over one diaphragm. Four screws.
parts.diaphragm_head_r: Head (casing) block. Holds the check valves over one diaphragm. Four screws.
parts.diaphragm_head_l_screws: Head screws. Four Phillips screws hold the head on.
parts.diaphragm_head_r_screws: Head screws. Four Phillips screws hold the head on.
parts.diaphragm_block_l: Diaphragm block. The rubber diaphragm that pumps the air. A torn one stops the pump.
parts.diaphragm_block_r: Diaphragm block. The rubber diaphragm that pumps the air. A torn one stops the pump.
parts.diaphragm_nut_l: U-lock nut. Holds the diaphragm block on the rod. Use a new one going back.
parts.diaphragm_nut_r: U-lock nut. Holds the diaphragm block on the rod. Use a new one going back.
parts.safety_screw: Safety screw. A torn diaphragm lets the rod break it, which cuts the power on purpose. Replace it after the diaphragm.
parts.blower_top_screw: Filter cover screw. One screw holds the filter cover down.
