parts.blower_cover_screws: Housing screws. Four long screws in the corners hold the upper housing down.
parts.blower_cord_run: Blower cord. From the pump to its plug.
parts.blower_plug: Blower plug. Pull it by the body, never the cord. Unplugged, the plant gets no air and no alarm.
parts.alarm_air_tube: Alarm air tube. A small line from the air stub up to the pressure switch in the panel; when the air stops, the switch sounds the alarm.
parts.head_can: Rotor can. The housing threaded on the swing pipe, flush with the lawn. It stays in the ground.
parts.head_top: Twist lock top. Unscrew it and the whole sprinkler assembly lifts out with it.
parts.head_assembly: Sprinkler assembly. The riser, gear drive and turret. Lifts out of the can for cleaning.
parts.head_filter: Inlet filter. On the bottom of the assembly. Effluent fines clog it; rinse it and push it back on.
parts.head_riser: Riser. Pops up when the pump runs and turns the nozzle across its arc.
parts.head_nozzle: Nozzle. Sets the throw and the flow. Low angle on these 22 ft heads.
parts.head_nozzle_screw: Nozzle retention screw. Holds the nozzle in; it is also the break up screw, so too far in shortens the throw.
parts.spray_tee: Spray tee. The purple line's tee and the black swing pipe up to the head.
parts.spray_tee_cap_b: End cap. The last head on the line has nothing past its tee, so the tee's far stub is capped.
parts.stop_hot_plug: Integral stop. The shower valve's own shutoff for the hot side: a quarter turn with a flat screwdriver, slot vertical is shut.
parts.stop_cold_plug: Integral stop. The shower valve's own shutoff for the cold side: a quarter turn with a flat screwdriver, slot vertical is shut.
parts.retainer_clip: Retainer clip. The U shaped clip that locks the cartridge in the valve. Out, the water can push the cartridge out.
parts.handle_washer: Handle washer. Sits in the back of the handle's hub.
parts.arm_flange: Flange. The trim ring that covers the hole the shower arm comes through.
parts.spout_setscrew: Clamp screw. Holds a slip fit tub spout on its copper: 5/32 in hex, from underneath.
parts.spout_oring: O ring. Seals the slip fit spout on the copper.
parts.head_washer: Showerhead washer. The rubber washer in the head's socket that seals it on the arm. It also holds the flow restrictor.
parts.faceplate_screw_top: Faceplate screw. One of the two long screws beside the trip lever that hold the plate and the trip mechanism on the tub.
parts.faceplate_screw_bottom: Faceplate screw. One of the two long screws beside the trip lever that hold the plate and the trip mechanism on the tub.
parts.trip_linkage: Trip linkage. The rod, wire and drop cylinder behind a tub's overflow plate. The cylinder drops into the tee to hold water; hair on it slows the drain.
parts.strainer_cover: Strainer cover. The perforated plate screwed over a tub's strainer body. It catches hair; one screw and it lifts off.
parts.strainer_cover_screw: Cover screw. Holds the strainer cover on the strainer body's cross bar.
parts.retainer_plate: Retainer plate. Clamps the overflow elbow to the tub from inside the overflow hole, behind the faceplate.
parts.trap_water: Trap seal. The water a trap holds so sewer gas cannot come up the drain.
parts.riser_hot: Hot riser. The copper line that brings the hot water up to the valve.
parts.riser_cold: Cold riser. The copper line that brings the cold water up to the valve.
parts.index_cap_hot: Index button. The red H on the knob; pry it out to reach the handle screw.
parts.index_cap_cold: Index button. The blue C on the knob; pry it out to reach the handle screw.
parts.handle_screw_hot: Handle screw. Holds the knob on the stem.
parts.handle_screw_cold: Handle screw. Holds the knob on the stem.
parts.stem_washer_hot: Seat washer. The rubber washer on the end of the stem that shuts the water off against the seat. Worn, the spout drips.
parts.stem_washer_cold: Seat washer. The rubber washer on the end of the stem that shuts the water off against the seat. Worn, the spout drips.
parts.stem_washer_screw_hot: Bibb screw. Holds the washer on the end of the stem.
parts.stem_washer_screw_cold: Bibb screw. Holds the washer on the end of the stem.
parts.angle_stop_handle: Stop handle. A quarter turn clockwise shuts the water to the toilet; in line with the outlet is open.
parts.angle_stop_stem: Stop stem. Turns the ball inside the stop with the handle.
parts.stop_stub: Copper stub. The pipe out of the wall the stop compresses onto.
parts.stop_nut_in: Inlet compression nut. Squeezes the ferrule onto the copper; it stays on the stub when the stop comes off.
parts.stop_ferrule: Ferrule. The brass ring the nut crushes onto the copper to seal; a new one goes on with a new stop if the old one is scored.
parts.supply_nut_stop: 3/8 compression nut. Holds the supply line on the stop's outlet: snug plus a quarter turn.
parts.supply_nut_fill: Coupling nut. Holds the supply line on the fill valve's shank. Hand tight only: a wrench cracks it.
parts.fill_locknut: Fill valve locknut. Holds the fill valve in the tank from underneath; hand tight.
parts.fill_shank_washer: Shank washer. Seals the fill valve's shank in the tank's hole; wide side up.
parts.fill_cap: Fill valve cap. An eighth turn and it lifts off to change the seal or flush out grit.
parts.fill_seal_242: Fill valve seal. The rubber seal under the cap that shuts the water off; worn, the valve hisses.
parts.refill_tube: Refill tube. Sends a little water down the overflow to refill the bowl after a flush.
parts.flush_locknut: Flush valve locknut. Holds the flush valve in the tank from underneath.
parts.spud_gasket: Spud gasket. The rubber gasket between the tank and the bowl; a new one every time the tank comes off.
parts.handle_nut: Trip lever nut. Holds the handle in the tank; left hand thread, it loosens clockwise.
parts.hinge_pin: Hinge pin. The seat and lid turn on it.
parts.ballcock_locknut: Ballcock locknut. Holds the old ballcock in the tank from underneath.
parts.wax_ring_section: Wax ring, cut. Sealed between the toilet's horn and the flange; it never reseals once broken.
parts.spud_gasket_section: Spud gasket, cut. The water from the tank goes through it into the bowl.
parts.float_safety: High water float. The safety switch's own float: it rises past the pump's start level and opens the furnace's R circuit before the tank runs over.
parts.reservoir_section: Reservoir. The small tank the condensate pump collects water in before it pumps it out.
parts.inlet_hose_run: Inlet line. Carries the furnace's condensate down into the pump.
parts.inlet_hose_end: Inlet line. Carries the furnace's condensate down into the pump.
parts.discharge_tube_run: Discharge tube. The small line the condensate pump pushes water up through.
parts.discharge_tube_end: Discharge tube. The small line the condensate pump pushes water up through.
parts.safety_lead_com: Safety switch lead. One of the pump's two black high water switch leads, spliced into the furnace's R circuit.
parts.safety_lead_no: Safety switch lead. One of the pump's two black high water switch leads, spliced into the furnace's R circuit.
parts.safety_wire_nut_com: Wire nut. Twists two conductors together and covers the splice.
parts.safety_wire_nut_no: Wire nut. Twists two conductors together and covers the splice.
parts.safety_cable: Thermostat cable. 18/2 low voltage cable from the pump's safety switch splice to the furnace's control.
parts.power_cord_plug: Power cord. Plugs the unit into its receptacle.
parts.power_cord_run: Power cord. Plugs the unit into its receptacle.
parts.sub_door: Wallplate door. Covers the wiring hole; it swings down on its hinge so the wires can be landed.
parts.sub_slider_r_rc: R/Rc Slider Tab. The wallplate's built in jumper: up joins R and Rc (one transformer), down keeps them apart (two).
parts.sub_level: Level. The bubble the plate is set level by.
parts.cable_jacket: Thermostat cable. The jacket the conductors run in, up the wall to the indoor unit.
parts.filter_head: Filter head. The in and out head on the tank's neck: the water goes in one port and down round the riser, through the carbon, and comes back up the riser and out the other port. It unscrews off the neck for a media change; the o-ring under it is the seal that weeps (silicone grease only).
parts.filter_head_oring: Head o-ring. Seals the head to the tank's neck. Silicone grease only, never petroleum jelly; dry or pinched, the neck weeps into the soil.
parts.filter_head_riser_oring: Riser o-ring. Seals the riser into the head's pilot so the incoming water cannot cut across to the outlet without going through the bed.
parts.filter_head_pex_adapter_in: PEX adapter. A female brass adapter threaded onto the head's tailpiece and crimped into the PEX jumper. Back it off with a wrench while you hold the tailpiece.
parts.filter_head_pex_adapter_out: PEX adapter. A female brass adapter threaded onto the head's tailpiece and crimped into the PEX jumper. Back it off with a wrench while you hold the tailpiece.
parts.lid_bolt: Lid bolt. Holds the box lid down so a mower, a foot or a child cannot lift it. It stays in the lid when it comes off.
parts.union_city_nut: Union nut. Back it off by hand (channel locks to break it) and the union comes apart, so the manifold comes out without cutting pipe.
parts.union_house_nut: Union nut. Back it off by hand (channel locks to break it) and the union comes apart, so the manifold comes out without cutting pipe.
parts.union_city_tail: Union tail. Glued on the stub; the nut pulls on its shoulder.
parts.union_house_tail: Union tail. Glued on the stub; the nut pulls on its shoulder.
parts.union_city_body: Union body. Glued on the line; the nut threads onto it and its face holds the o-ring.
parts.union_house_body: Union body. Glued on the line; the nut threads onto it and its face holds the o-ring.
parts.union_city_oring: Union o-ring. The seal between the union's two faces; square faces and a clean o-ring make hand tight a seal.
parts.union_house_oring: Union o-ring. The seal between the union's two faces; square faces and a clean o-ring make hand tight a seal.
parts.riser_water: Water in the riser. Filtered water on its way up to the head's outlet.
parts.pitless_slide: Pitless slide. The inside half of a pitless adapter: the drop pipe hangs on it, and a T-handle threaded into its top lifts it off its seat to pull the pump.
parts.pitless_outer: Pitless outer half. Bolted through the well casing below frost: the water line leaves the well here, so nothing comes through the casing above ground.
parts.pitless_slide_oring: Pitless O-ring. Seals the slide to the outer half; a cut or dry one lets the water run back down the casing.
parts.tank_air_valve: Air valve. The Schrader valve on a diaphragm tank: read and set the air charge here with the tank empty of water.
parts.tank_air_cap: Air valve cap. Keeps dirt out of the tank's air valve and holds the charge if the core seeps.
parts.switch_cover_nut: Cover nut. Holds the pressure switch's cover on its stud.
parts.disconnect_toggle: Disconnect handle. ON up, OFF down. The line side of the switch stays live from the panel.
parts.ball_valve_handle: Ball valve handle. In line with the pipe is open, across it is closed.
parts.boiler_drain_wheel: Boiler drain handle. Opens the drain: a hose on its threads first.
parts.inlet_clamp: Clamp. A stainless band clamp holding poly pipe on a barbed fitting.
parts.well_cap_bolts: Set bolts. Hold the well cap on the casing; snug and even, never cranked.
parts.jbox_cover_gasket: Cover gasket. Keeps the rain off the splices in an outdoor box.
parts.outlet_union: Union. Lets a tank come out without cutting pipe: undo the nut and the two halves part.
parts.outlet_union_tail_low: Union. Lets a tank come out without cutting pipe: undo the nut and the two halves part.
parts.outlet_union_nut: Union. Lets a tank come out without cutting pipe: undo the nut and the two halves part.
parts.outlet_union_tail_up: Union. Lets a tank come out without cutting pipe: undo the nut and the two halves part.
parts.whs_wire_nut_black_1: Wire nut on line 1. The device's black lead and the black THHN twisted under it. Tug test it.
parts.whs_wire_nut_black_2: Wire nut on line 2. The device's other black lead and the black THHN. Tug test it.
parts.whs_wire_nut_green: Wire nut on the ground. The device's white lead, the green THHN and the box pigtail. On a 240 V heater the white goes to ground.
parts.whs_cover_screw_top: Cover screw. 6-32 into the box's ear.
parts.whs_cover_screw_bottom: Cover screw. 6-32 into the box's ear.
parts.whs_spd_locknut: Locknut on the device's nipple, inside the box. Backed off, it drops to the box floor.
parts.whs_soot_box: Soot on the box floor round the nipple. The device has failed, replace it.
parts.whs_spd_nipple_section: Cut open. The three leads run up the nipple's bore into the box.

_prefix.breaker_: Branch breaker. Feeds one circuit. It trips on an overload or a short. An arc fault or GFCI breaker also has a test button.
_prefix.romex_: NM cable. The house wiring from the breaker to the circuit: black hot, white neutral, bare ground.
_prefix.splice_: Splice. A crimped, heat shrunk joint in the pump wiring, zip tied high in the riser out of the water.
_prefix.float_: Float. Rides the water and switches the pump or the alarm.
_prefix.head_: Thermostat. Reads the room and calls the equipment for heat, cool or fan.
_prefix.spray_head: Spray head. Pops up and throws the treated water over the lawn.
_prefix.txv_: Part of the TXV, the valve that meters refrigerant into the coil.
_prefix.exp_tank_: Expansion tank. A bladder tank that absorbs the volume the water gains as it heats.
_prefix.cable_: Conductor. One wire of the feed.
_prefix.uf_: UF cable. Direct burial cable feeding the pump.
_prefix.sub_: Thermostat sub base. The terminals the thermostat wires land on: R power, C common, W heat, Y cool, G fan.
_prefix.lid_: Lid. The cover over a tank access.
_prefix.riser_: Riser. Brings an access up to grade.
_prefix.flo_: Part of the Flo automatic shutoff valve.
_prefix.hoa_: Hand Off Auto switch. Hand runs the pump now, Off stops it, Auto lets the floats run it.
_prefix.hammer_: Water hammer arrestor. A piston in a cylinder that absorbs the bang when a valve slams shut.
_prefix.recirc_: Recirculation. A small pump and return line that keep hot water at the far taps.
_prefix.ro_: Reverse osmosis. Pushes water through a membrane into a small tank for the drinking faucet.
_prefix.tb1_: Terminal. A screw on the panel's terminal strip.
_prefix.jumper_: Jumper. A short wire between two terminals.
_prefix.fuse_: Fuse. Protects one circuit in the panel.
_prefix.panel_wire_: Panel wiring. One of the conductors inside the control panel.
_prefix.main_: Main. The service feed's landing in the panel.
_prefix.lower_: Lower element side of the water heater.
_prefix.upper_: Upper element side of the water heater.
_prefix.chlor: Chlorine. Disinfects the treated water before it is sprayed.
_prefix.condensate_: Condensate. The water that drips off a cold coil or out of a condensing burner.
_prefix.stop_: Stop. The shutoff under the fixture.
_prefix.compressor: Compressor. The pump at the heart of the refrigeration system.
_prefix.contactor: Contactor. The relay that switches the high voltage to the compressor and fan.
_prefix.capacitor: Capacitor. Stores a charge that helps a motor start and run.
_prefix.disconnect: Disconnect. Kills the unit's power for service.
_prefix.anode: Anode rod. Corrodes so the tank does not.
_prefix.inducer: Inducer. Pulls the draft before the burners light.
_prefix.lineset: Line set. The refrigerant lines between the units.
_prefix.cleanout: Cleanout. Where a cable goes into the drain.
_prefix.trap: Trap. Holds water to block sewer gas.
_prefix.cartridge: Cartridge. The valve inside the faucet.
_prefix.effluent: Effluent. The treated water leaving the tank.
_prefix.brine: Brine. Salt water that recharges the resin.
_prefix.resin: Resin. The beads that soften the water.
_prefix.carbon: Carbon media. Takes chlorine and taste out of the water.
_prefix.bus: Bus bar. The live bars the breakers snap onto.
_prefix.diffuser: Diffuser. Breaks the air into bubbles.
_prefix.aer: Aeration. Air bubbled through the sewage to keep the bacteria working.
_prefix.clarifier: Clarifier. Where the solids settle out.
_prefix.take_up_: Expansion. Heated water grows, and this is where the extra goes: back up the cold line into the expansion tank.
_prefix.waterlogged_spike_: Pressure spike. With no working expansion tank the pressure climbs every time the heater fires, and the relief valve lets it go.
_prefix.rumble_: Steam pocket. Water trapped under the sediment flashes to steam over the burner and pops up through it: the rumble you hear.
_prefix.fresh_packet_: Fresh outside air, on its way through the ERV core into the house.
_prefix.stale_packet_: Stale house air, on its way through the ERV core and out the roof cap.
_prefix.purify_packets_: Oxidizers and ions off the purifier's cell, carried through the ducts with the supply air.
_prefix.packets_: What is moving through the part, drawn as packets so you can follow it.
_prefix.fix_hosebib_: Hose bib. The house's own outside faucet on a frost free barrel through the wall. A drip at the handle is the packing; a wobble in the wall is the mount.
_prefix.corner_louver_: Corner louver. One of the louvered corner posts that guard the outdoor coil. They come off with the shell for a coil cleaning.
_prefix.trench: Drain field trench. Gravel and a perforated line where the tank's clear water soaks into the soil.
_prefix.hinge_post_: Hinge post. Bolted to the bowl; the seat's pin turns in it.
_prefix.hinge_cap_: Hinge cap. Pry it up with a flat screwdriver to reach the seat bolt.
_prefix.seat_bolt_: Seat bolt. Holds a hinge post down through the bowl; plastic, snug only.
_prefix.seat_nut_: Seat nut. Holds the seat bolt from under the deck.
_prefix.tank_bolt_seal_: Tank bolt seal. The rubber under the bolt's head inside the tank; when it hardens the bolt seeps.
_prefix.tank_bolt_: Tank bolt. Holds the tank down on the bowl.
_prefix.tank_nut_washer_: Tank bolt washer. Under the nut, below the bowl's shelf.
_prefix.tank_nut_: Tank bolt nut. Under the bowl's shelf; tightened a little at a time, side to side, until the tank sits level.
_prefix.closet_bolt_: Closet bolt. Stands in the flange's slot and holds the toilet down.
_prefix.closet_nut_: Closet nut. Holds the toilet on its bolt; snug, alternately, never cranked.
_prefix.closet_washer_: Closet bolt washer. Under the closet nut.
_prefix.bolt_cap_: Bolt cap. Covers the closet bolt; pops off with a flat screwdriver.
_prefix.bolt_cap_base_: Bolt cap base. The plastic washer the cap snaps onto.
_prefix.sub_tab_: Release. Press it and the wire lets go of its push in terminal (an ecobee lever, a Nest button, a T4 Pro tab).
_prefix.sub_term_: Push in terminal. One thermostat wire goes in here, by the letter beside it.
_prefix.sub_boss_: Connector. One of the Nest base's push button connectors: the wire goes into its side and the button stays down.
_prefix.sub_mount_screw_: Mounting screw. Holds the wallplate to the wall, into a plastic anchor.
_prefix.sub_wall_anchor_: Wall anchor. The plastic sleeve in the drywall the plate's screw goes into; it stays when the plate comes off.
_prefix.battery_aa_: AA battery. Keeps the programmable stat's clock and program, and runs it when there is no C wire. A blank screen is often these.
